title: When Hilbert functions determine four-variable generic initial ideals
summary: Over a field of characteristic zero, we characterize the Hilbert functions that determine the degree reverse lexicographic generic initial ideal among Artinian quotients in four variables with the $2$-strong Lefschetz property. Our criterion is a finite numerical test that strictly extends the quasi-symmetry condition of Harima and Wachi. The proof parametrizes the possible generic initial ideals by flags of lower sets in the Borel orders on their common three-variable section.
